caption: _helpers.tpl holds reusable named templates every manifest can call.

code:
apiVersion: v2
name: myapp
description: A Helm chart for the myapp API service
type: application
version: 0.3.0        # the chart's own version
appVersion: "2.1.4"    # the app it deploys by default
caption: version tracks the chart; appVersion tracks the app — they move independently.
include calls a shared helper; toYaml/nindent drops a whole values block in correctly.

eyebrow: Validate before it touches a cluster

steps.label: helm lint ./myapp
steps.sub: catches structural problems and missing required values

steps.label: helm template ./myapp --values values.yaml
steps.sub: renders final YAML locally, no cluster involved

steps.label: Read the output
steps.sub: confirm it's correct before helm install ever runs
